create_lakera_ai_guardrail: create a LakeraAIGuardrail instance with API key, project ID, and on_flagged policy
call_lakera_v2_guard: call the Lakera AI v2 guard API to scan messages for PII and policy violations
mask_pii_in_messages: mask detected PII entities in message content with [MASKED TYPE] tokens
run_pre_call_guardrail: run the Lakera AI pre-call hook to block or mask messages before forwarding to an LLM
run_post_call_guardrail: run the Lakera AI post-call hook to mask PII in assistant responses after LLM generation
